description: A massive, snake-like guardian creature, the Venomfang Warden serves as a protector of ancient ruins deep within the jungle. It has emerald-green scales and glowing, venom-dripping fangs. Its keen senses make it an almost impossible foe to surprise.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: The Venomfang Warden has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Venomous Bite
traits.description: When the Venomfang Warden hits with its bite attack, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Venomfang Warden can't constrict another target.
